welcome_description: Your personal assistant for finding remote jobs, managing applications, and preparing for interviews. Let's get you set up in a few quick steps.
upload_cv_description: Upload your resume so we can help you match with the best job opportunities and optimize for ATS systems.
llm_description: Bring your own API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI or DeepSeek), or run models yourself with Ollama, to unlock CV optimization, cover letter generation, and interview preparation. Keys are stored encrypted on this device.
byot_hint: Get a key from your provider's console. It never leaves this device.
ollama_mode_lan: Another computer on my local network
ollama_hint_local: Install Ollama from ollama.com, keep it running and pull a model (e.g. ollama pull qwen3:8b).
ollama_hint_lan: IP or hostname of that computer. Start Ollama there with OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 so it accepts network connections.
ollama_hint_remote: Leave empty to use Ollama Cloud, or enter your own server's URL.
ollama_no_models: Connected, but no models are installed. Run ollama pull qwen3:8b on the server, then pick it in Settings.
cloud_options_description: You can add or change providers any time in Settings.
ready_description: Everything is configured. You can start searching for jobs right away or explore the app at your own pace.

error_boundary.title: Something Went Wrong
error_boundary.description: An unexpected error occurred. You can try restarting the app or report this issue.
